viewpoint.description: The creator reports a roadside stop near 15th Street SW and Country Club Road with the storm to the west near 6:10 PM. The foreground provides qualitative setting only.
viewpoint.basis: Attributed location and direction from the creator account, supplemented by per-frame visible foreground and occlusion. No measured position, bearing, lens or projection is supplied.

characteristics: A broad dark cloud underside occupies the center and right. A brighter opening on the left exposes a sloping tonal transition into a descending gray region.
Field, fence and utility poles provide foreground context.
boundary_limits: Only a partial margin is resolved. The opposite tornado flank and lowest termination cannot be identified.
These dark and gray regions are not individually established as tornado rather than surrounding cloud or intervening material. A complete cone, dimensions and extent are unsupported.
